Editorial 'A Clear-cut Issue': 'Return Delegate Victor S. K. Houston to the Congress at Washington.' Hawaii Territory Delegate to Congress race; Houston was incumbent.
Editorial 'Vote for Wright and Six Republican Supervisors' endorses incumbent Mayor Fred Wright of City and County of Honolulu.

Editorial 'Tomorrow's Election': 'A safe guide now is this: vote Republican... the Republican candidates generally are well qualified personally, beginning with Samuel W. King, whose qualifications are marked.' General endorsement of Republican ticket including Delegate to Congress.

Editorial 'Roosevelt's Election Predicted': 'It's no time to change leaders. Therefore, Franklin D. Roosevelt is destined to finish his job in Washington.' Note: Hawaii was a Territory in 1936 and could not vote in presidential elections, but this is an endorsement of FDR over Landon.

Editorial 'A Civic Duty To Elect George Denison' endorses him for the senate. Note: Hawaii was a Territory in 1936 with no US Senator; this refers to the Territorial Senate. Clipping is misleadingly labeled '1936 U.S. Senate' by the original clipper.
Editorial 'Senator Sylva's Campaign' endorses incumbent Republican Sen. Joseph L. Sylva for re-election to the Hawaii Territorial Senate. Pre-statehood (Territorial) legislature.

Editorial 'A Mayor For A Modern City' endorses Montie Richards for Mayor of City and County of Honolulu, citing his service as a member of the Board of Supervisors. Party not explicitly stated in clipping; Richards ran as Republican.
Editorial 'Return Farrington to Congress' endorses incumbent Delegate Joseph R. Farrington (R) over opponent Judge Delbert E. Metzger. Hawaii Territory Delegate to Congress race.
Editorial 'Neal Blaisdell's Fitness' endorses Neal Blaisdell for Mayor of Honolulu, calling him 'upright, responsible and competent young man.'
